requirements: Must have at least one child record with valid phoneNo
Child must be associated with a user (parent)
Must have at least one healthcare provider record
Must have vaccination records with Hali='inasubiri'
These records should have vaccination_no=NULL initially
vaccination_code must match the codes being tested
Parent user must exist and be linked to child
